{{Quote|<s></s>That is one ''ugly'' bug.|[[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], upon seeing a statue of Queen Karina|audio=OneUglyBug-LoT.flac|<ref name="LoT" />}}
'''Karina the Great''' was the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|Stalgasin hive]], and by extension, [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She also commanded a [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|hive]] of [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] Geonosian [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|warriors]] through the use of [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worms]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Watch as my child enters your Jedi friend.|Karina the Great|audio=WatchMyChild-LoT.flac|<ref name="LoT" />}}
[[File:Karina_hall.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] talking to Queen Karina.]]
Unlike most members of her [[Species/Legends|species]], she had six [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] instead of four, and a huge [[Ovipositor|egg-laying organ]], which produced an [[Egg/Legends|egg]] roughly once every eight [[Time/Legends|seconds]]. She commanded a [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|hive]] of [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] Geonosian [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|warriors]], through use of [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worms]], from her lair under the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]].<ref name="LoT" />

She was originally thought to be only a myth, until [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] hid in the temple with her, unaware that he was being followed by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Buzz/Legends|Buzz]]. The Jedi and the clone entered Karina's temple, but were quickly attacked by the undead Geonosians. Buzz was killed and Unduli was taken prisoner. When Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] tracked Luminara down to Karina herself, Obi-Wan wanted to negotiate with her and find out how the brain worms worked. However, Queen Karina was presumably killed by the clone troopers who had shot down the structure of the temple while saving the three Jedi, allowing it to topple over her and trap her under the rubble.<ref name="LoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karina was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voices all of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="LoT Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode207.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Legacy of Terror}}</ref>

"[[Legacy of Terror]]" is notable for containing several similarities to the [[1986]] movie [[Wikipedia:Aliens (film)|''Aliens'']]: Just like the [[W:c:avp:Queen (Acheron)|alien queen]] from the science fiction film, Karina the Great is the leader of a hive of aliens and lays [[egg]]s, and her giant [[Ovipositor|egg sac]] and the fan-shaped growth on top of her head look, strikingly similar to the queen from the movie.
